premise.claim: rollingUpdatePartition indexes states past the end of the slice when the live StatefulSet replica count is lower than the role's desired count by more than maxUnavailable plus the number of continuously ready replicas; the panic is recovered by controller-runtime and the workload does not converge.
premise.evidence: results/premise-base.txt (issue #547 repro panics on base 98d3c4be); results/unit-base.txt (panic at sts_reconciler.go:421); results/integration-summary.txt (controller panic loop, sts stuck at replicas=1); results/unit-base-round2.txt (re-confirmed on round-2 frozen baseSha 73e05db4 after the PR rebase: identical index-out-of-range panic)
